summary: Build discovery, qualification, and solution-selling skills in 5 days. Learn MEDDICC, SPIN Selling, and account planning.
lede: Solution selling training helps sales professionals uncover client needs and shape relevant proposals. It supports people managing discovery, qualification, and account growth with structured questioning, stakeholder mapping, opportunity assessment, value-based proposal framing, objection handling, and account planning to connect offerings to client priorities and guide next steps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for sales professionals who manage discovery, qualification, solution framing, and account growth in complex selling environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of sales, account management, business development, or client-facing experience. A working understanding of pipeline stages, CRM usage, and basic commercial proposal development is recommended. No coding or programming is required. If you bring live account examples, a laptop, and access to your current opportunity notes or CRM fields, you will get more value from the practical exercises.
